Our story

A love of fashion.
A belief in your potential.

Behind every beautifully made garment is a skill that can be taught, practised and made your own.

MEET YOUR TUTOR

Hello,
I’m Gracy.

I am the tutor and founder behind ISew. I teach pattern drafting, cutting and construction to students across Nigeria, Ghana and Kenya.

My classes focus on accurate measurement, clear drafting and finishing you can be proud of. They are built around practical skills you can return to for your own projects and your clients.

The academy brings teaching, community support and learning resources together. Before joining, let us talk about your experience and what you want to make next.

Design. Draft. Create. Empower.
